scope: Frozen before reading current-engine native metrics; confirm only after discovery results are recorded.

patterns.early_income_without_deaths: Rival earnedGold minus ours at R150 >=100, and both teams have zero deaths at R150.
patterns.early_gem_acquisition: Rival collectedGems at R300 exceeds ours.
patterns.first_bank_later: Both teams deposit, and our first deposit round exceeds rival first deposit round.
patterns.fewer_wards_300: Our wardPlacement count through R300 is below rival count.
patterns.damage_conversion_gap: Our monsterDamageDone through R300 >= rival, but our collectedGems through R300 < rival.
patterns.midgame_total_gems_deficit: At R800, own submittedGems plus held gems is below rival submittedGems plus held gems; games ending before R800 reported separately.

interpretation: Descriptive associations in an outcome-selected case sample, with group clustering and imperfect source identity. No causal estimate, champion decision or policy tuned on confirmation.
